description: This file defines a custom Android UI layout component named 'CardLayout', extending RelativeLayout, with custom touch event handling to implement swipe detection and visual effects.

classes.name: CardLayout
classes.description: A custom layout component that detects swipe gestures and manages touch interaction effects.

methods.name: CardLayout
methods.description: Constructors to initialize the CardLayout with different parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes focusability and touch configuration, including touch slop.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch end events for swipe effects.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Intercepts motion events to detect horizontal swipe gestures based on touch slop.
